Name: Better Recycling Y Smelting
Author: NextAttempt
Description:
[quote][color=#d4d4d8]DETAILED DESCRIPTION[/color][/quote]
[color=#d4d4d8]Tired of having chest after chest full of useless junk?[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]We all know the struggle: you end up with hundreds of Sap, Dwarf Scrolls you’ve already donated, and dozens of weird geode minerals that have no sale value or use. Instead of throwing them away or letting them gather dust, this mod turns them into the resources you actually need![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]---------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[quote][color=#d4d4d8] WHAT CAN YOU DO NOW?[/color][/quote]

[color=#d4d4d8]---------------------------------------------------------[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]▶ NO MORE HOARDING SAP![/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Don't throw away your sap anymore. Put it in the Furnace (20 units) to distill it and get Pine Tar or Oak Resin. Free and fast tree resources![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]▶ DWARF SCROLLS ARE NO LONGER JUNK:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]After donating the 4 scrolls to the museum, the next ones you find are worthless. Now you can put them in the Recycling Machine to get Cloth![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]▶ CLEAR OUT YOUR GEODE MINERALS:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Stop storing minerals that nobody wants. Run them through the Recycling Machine to extract basic materials:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Hematite/Pyrite -> Real Iron Ore![/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Bixite/Tiger's Eye -> Pure Gold Ore![/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Sandstone/Mudstone -> Clay for your Silos![/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]---------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8] [/color]
[quote][color=#d4d4d8]REQUISITOS E INSTALACIÓN / REQUIREMENTS [/color][/quote]
[color=#d4d4d8]---------------------------------------------------------[/color]
